title: The Thorn Lion
text: A lion limps along the path with a thorn as long as a dagger in its paw, the wound swollen and weeping. It growls at anyone who comes near, a deep sound that shakes the grass. Its eyes are wild with pain.

options.label: The bravest pulls the thorn, trusting the lion to know a kindness.

outcomes.text: It purrs like rocks rolling and guards your camp that night.

options.label: Give it a wide berth; pain makes any beast dangerous.

outcomes.text: You go the long way round. It limps after you, growling, so nobody rests.
You go the long way round, but it follows. The thorn has made it mean.

options.label: The Leader puts it out of its misery.

outcomes.text: It is not as weak as it looks.
